summary: Republic Power Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing that it and an unnamed institutional investor terminated the investor's additional investment right under a July 20, 2026 securities purchase agreement. The right would have let the investor buy a second set of identical transaction documents at its sole discretion within one year. The company paid a one-time $250,000 cash fee, with termination effective October 2, 2026. The original $570,000 convertible note, issued in two tranches, remains outstanding. No board recommendation or advisor was named. Watch for dilution from note conversion and any future financing.
